edges.reason: Constructor assigns msg.sender into addrAdmin, granting full admin rights to first caller

setFinance validates msg.sender against addrFinance or addrAdmin before changing finance address
withdraw requires msg.sender equals addrFinance or addrAdmin
onlyAdmin modifier requires msg.sender == addrAdmin

A malicious receiver contract could attempt to re-enter withdraw during the ether transfer
_rand builds randomness from blockhash, block.coinbase and block.difficulty
Weak randomness result is written into the _seed state variable
_seed is read and mutated by _rand on every call, making the PRNG predictable
Predictable seed values feed _getFashionParam attribute generation
_safeTransferFrom calls ERC721TokenReceiver(_to).onERC721Received on an attacker-controlled address

normalization_plan.reason: _newAdmin is only used to overwrite addrAdmin inside setAdmin
_target only determines the withdraw receiver and has no independent meaning
_amount is consumed entirely by the withdraw transfer branches
_owner is only the beneficiary of the minted token in createFashion
_attrs are copied into the new Fashion struct inside createFashion
_createType is only emitted in the CreateFashion event
ethVal is the sole subject of the ether split logic in _transferHelper
_orderIndex only selects the ordersArray entry to resolve
_seed only seeds the attribute RNG inside miningResolve
_miner is only stored into the new MiningOrder by _addOrder
_chestCnt is only stored into the new MiningOrder by _addOrder
_tokenId merely identifies the token handled by transferFrom
receiver is the direct destination of the external transfer in withdraw
balance is a transient snapshot used only to branch the withdraw amount
owner is a transient ownership check used by the transfer flow
seed local is the direct output of _rand consumed by mining paths
newFashionId is a transient index derived inside createFashion
rdm is a loop/scratch value used only inside _getFashionParam
fVal is a transient share value immediately transferred out
pVal is a transient share value immediately transferred out
indexFrom is a transient array index used only during _transfer
